description: Mark credential fields and recovery-code elements left unmarked by the current official spec (https://github.com/clerk/openapi-specs/blob/94753d1d8a648806e4dc529beec8bb76daa13859/platform/beta.yml) and the converter's default sensitive-name rules: PlatformCreateJWTTemplate and PlatformUpdateJWTTemplate signing_key are documented custom signing private keys; PlatformApplicationTransferResponse.code lets the recipient claim application ownership; PlatformClaimAccountlessApplication.token is documented as a single-use ownership claim token. Historical #701 evidence (https://github.com/wyattjoh/distilled/blob/29a40f857b7b23c789c75a3b139d238c1c493c46/packages/clerk/patches/platform/sensitive-secrets.patch.json) records 2026-10-02 live create/update accepting an RS256 PKCS#8 signing key and transfer creation returning a claim code; the claim token's sensitivity follows documented credential semantics, not a live claim. No new live validation was performed. The same pinned spec documents PlatformCreateInstanceUserRequest.backup_codes as plaintext backup codes or bcrypt digests; PhoneNumber.backup_codes carries the corresponding recovery credentials. Mark each list element, preserving both the array and redacted element types. User password and totp_secret and instance secret_key are already sensitive and are not patched.
